title: White Mesh Graphic Tee & Ruffled Denim
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy brown hair and a white bow hair clip stands full-length against a light gray backdrop. She wears a fitted white mesh cap-sleeve top with a black bow graphic across the chest. A medium wash denim midi skirt with a ruffled asymmetric slit and a brown belt with a plush bear charm sits at the waist. Black crossbody bag, patterned socks, and chunky silver sneakers complete the look. Her expression is calm, with one hand raised to her hair. Soft, even studio light. Palette of white, faded denim, and charcoal. Playful and feminine, in the style of a Y2K lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The bow graphic and ruffled denim slit are the key details.
- Keep the bear charm as a playful accent.
